Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Renewals Team is a strategic partner to Stripe's Sales organization, helping Stripe retain and expand revenue from its portfolio of existing users. We bring analytical rigor, commercial judgment, and operational discipline to the renewal process so account teams can navigate complex decisions with clarity, accuracy, and speed.

We work closely with Sales, Deal Pricing, Deal Strategy, Customer Success and other cross-functional partners throughout the renewal lifecycle. The team analyzes account performance and contractual history, builds renewal scenarios, and develops recommendations that inform deal strategy and negotiation planning led by Account Executives. We also improve the systems and processes that enable Stripe to manage renewals at scale.

What you’ll do

As a Renewals Specialist, you will partner with account teams and cross-functional stakeholders to protect and grow Stripe's revenue. This is an analytical role at its core. You will combine quantitative analysis and financial modeling with user context to assess renewal options, identify risks and opportunities, and help teams make well-supported commercial decisions.

You will work on large, complex renewals, balancing the needs of Stripe and our users while helping account teams move deals forward on schedule. Success requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to build trusted relationships across teams. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, respectfully challenging assumptions, and engaging in constructive debate to reach better outcomes. You will also help design scalable processes so the team can handle fluctuating volumes while maintaining a high standard of operational excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Account Executives to develop and execute strategies for retaining and expanding revenue from existing users.
  • Manage a portfolio of upcoming renewals, tracking milestones, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder actions.
  • Analyze historical pricing, product usage, account performance, and contractual terms to develop renewal recommendations.
  • Build financial models and renewal scenarios that clarify commercial tradeoffs and support data-driven decisions.
  • Partner on deal strategy and negotiation planning for large or complex renewals, providing analysis and a clear point of view to support commercial negotiations led by Account Executives.
  • Identify retention risks, expansion opportunities, and changes in user needs by combining feedback from Sales and Customer Success with account-level data.
  • Support accurate, timely quote and proposal development with account teams and cross-functional partners.
  • Build strong working relationships across Sales, Customer Success, Deal Pricing, Deal Strategy, and the technical and operational teams involved in the renewal lifecycle.
  • Report on renewal performance, risks, and recommendations through clear weekly, monthly, and quarterly updates.
  • Identify and implement scalable improvements to renewal workflows through tooling, automation, and the responsible use of AI-assisted solutions.
  • Contribute to a team culture grounded in ownership, integrity, intellectual honesty, and collaboration.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in renewals, strategic account management, sales, customer success, or a related field, ideally in a high-growth technology environment.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and experience building financial models, pricing analyses, or business cases that turn complex data into clear recommendations.
  • Sound business judgment, with the ability to weigh competing priorities, risks, and tradeoffs in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence partners without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions while constructively challenging assumptions and helping teams reach sound decisions.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with demonstrated experience prioritizing multiple time-sensitive workstreams, meeting deadlines, maintaining accuracy, and improving the processes that support the work.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in payments, financial services, or FinTech.
  • Experience with contract renewals, pricing discussions, or complex deal structures.
  • Familiarity with recurring-revenue or consumption-based business models, and with CRM, quoting, or business-intelligence tools.
  • Comfort using AI-assisted tools to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and process improvement, with sound judgment around accuracy and appropriate data handling.

About the Company:

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

The People team is the engine behind World’s most important asset: its people. We build, support, and scale a global organization of exceptional talent. We design experiences that attract world-class builders and retain, recognize, reward, and enable them to do the best work of their lives.

About the role

We’re looking for a People Operations Manager to shape how employees and managers experience working at World, from onboarding through major career and life changes. You’ll own how our core People programs run today and help shape where we invest next. You’ll use employee feedback, support trends, and your own experience handling complex cases to set priorities, bring the right partners together, and see improvements through rollout. Success means employees can get routine things done easily and count on thoughtful, accurate support when the stakes are high.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead day-to-day operations across onboarding, mobility, benefits, compensation, and sensitive organizational changes. Handle complex requests from intake through resolution, keeping employees and managers informed along the way

  • Use employee feedback and support trends to spot where people get stuck. Recommend what to fix first, make the change, and check whether it reduced delays or repeat questions

  • Keep employee data accurate. Run regular audits, resolve discrepancies, and fix the underlying process when the same errors recur

  • Make workflows easier to run as volume grows. Simplify handoffs, automate repetitive steps, and give the team clear guidance for handling exceptions

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • The ability to break a process down into its core components and identify the root causes for gaps or inefficiencies

  • Strong operational judgment and experience handling sensitive, time-critical employee matters with precision, empathy, and clear written communication

  • Hands-on experience maintaining accurate employee data and building reports in an HR system, ideally Workday, along with experience automating repetitive workflows using tools such as Google Apps Script, Python, or SQL

  • Proven cross-functional influence - bringing Legal, Finance, and People stakeholders together to resolve ambiguity and move decisions forward

  • An appetite for the day-to-day work of People Operations, from personally guiding an employee through a difficult case to improving the process for the next person

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About the team

The payments landscape is changing rapidly and our team is at the forefront of this change. Depending on where you live, you may be used to paying with a credit card or bank direct debit (United States), iDEAL (Netherlands) or UPI (India), amongst hundreds of other global payment methods. It turns out how you pay is increasingly dependent on where you are and what business you're buying from.
The Core Payments team makes it easy for businesses global and domestic to offer familiar local payment experiences wherever their customers choose to pay. We build bank payment methods and local payment experiences, alongside the capabilities that make these methods easier to discover, integrate, and use across Stripe. Responsible for building Stripe's payment platform that allows us to build and distribute payment methods at scale. The team works across product, engineering, design, data science, partnerships, risk, and go-to-market teams to help businesses offer locally relevant payment experiences at global scale.

What you’ll do

As a Product Manager, you’ll own relationships with some of the world’s largest payment providers and build products that drive billions in payment volume growth. You’ll help merchants offer locally relevant payment methods online and in person, improve payment performance, and expand acceptance across borders and into use cases such as recurring and agentic payments.

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

Paxos is positioning itself as a connected platform to create, custody, distribute and utilize digital assets, and Custody is the control plane of those assets. The Custody product team owns the capabilities that let institutional customers hold, control, and move assets securely, and works hand in hand with Engineering, Compliance/Legal, Operations, and Go-To-Market teams to win tier-1 financial institutions globally.

About the role

Custody is where institutions decide whether they can trust Paxos with their assets. As Senior Product Manager, Custody, you’ll own the product that holds and secures those assets, including wallet management and the controls around how assets move, and set its direction as demand grows from crypto-native firms to banks, asset managers, and wealth platforms.

You’ll form a point of view on where institutional custody is heading and what Paxos needs to build to lead there, then drive it from strategy through launch. That means deciding where to invest to meet the security bar institutions require while staying flexible enough for how customers actually operate. You’ll work through technically deep problems with Engineering and learn directly from institutional clients what it takes for them to go live, turning their requirements into the product.

This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of a strategy that drives institutional adoption of our custody products.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Custody strategy and roadmap, and drive it through execution, from defining requirements to launch and iteration

  • Define the security and control capabilities institutional customers rely on to protect and govern their assets, including wallet management and the controls around how assets are held and moved

  • Drive the infrastructure and integrations that extend Custody to meet institutional requirements, including relationships with third-party providers and partners

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to deliver capabilities that are secure, usable, and meet the regulatory expectations of institutional clients

  • Work with Go-To-Market teams to drive adoption of new capabilities, from positioning and client onboarding to feedback that shapes what comes next

  • Engage directly with institutional customers and prospects, and turn their requirements into capabilities that serve the broader client base

  • About you

We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is financing a rapidly growing portfolio of data center developments, with a mix of project-level debt, corporate facilities, and capital markets executions. This role is primarily transaction driven, helping to execute on debt financings from initial lease review, financial modeling, preparing marketing materials, term sheet and lender negotiations, through to documentation, diligence, and financial close. Post funding responsibilities will be to support compliance and lender reporting across active facilities.

This is a hands-on, execution-oriented, relationship driven role with active cross functional workstreams with other leaders across Riot’s finance/corporate development, treasury, legal, accounting, and data center groups. The role will also serve as a liaison between Riot and and the lender and investor community, including banks, agents, rating agencies, and outside counsel.

This is a remote position with travel up to 25% travel for lender/investor meetings, site visits, Riot corporate off sites.

What you'll do

  • Execute on the capital markets strategy, supporting debt financings across the spectrum including construction loans, project finance, corporate facilities, and capital markets issuances.
  • Manage the deal process from end to end, across multiple concurrent workstreams: including structuring, financial modelling, negotiating, documentation, and closing.
  • Review financing and legal documents including term sheets, credit agreements, security and collateral documents, guarantees, hedging arrangements and related lease agreements.
  • Prepare lender and rating agency presentations, term sheet summaries, and materials for senior management, Board approvals and earnings presentations.
  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses across different financing structures or assumptions, capital costs, and equity requirements,
  • Monitor ongoing compliance and lender reporting across live facilities, including covenant calculations and compliance certificates.

What you'll have

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, accounting, engineering, mathematics, or a related field. CFA or MBA preferred.
  • 7-10+ years in investment banking, project or corporate finance, treasury and capital markets, leveraged finance, private equity or a similar role. Data center, power, energy or real estate experience preferred.
  • Advanced Excel skills in financial modeling (including cash flow modeling and debt mechanics) and strong PowerPoint skills.
  • Experience with project finance/bank market, high-yield, ABS or private placement debt, including a deep knowledge of the broader financial and capital markets and macroeconomic dynamic
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple deadlines at once, strong negotiator, and clear communication skills

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: $190,000-$200,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
